Image2 rough mock is secondary for exact Japanese localized content/layout. Do not copy its green/mint history icons. Image3 approved bus is surface/action STYLE ONLY.
Single compact white section: date label "今日"; exactly FOUR history rows; then ONE centered action.
Exact text/order:
row1 "代々木公園" / "東京都渋谷区"
row2 "地域の図書館" / "東京都渋谷区"

row4 "宿泊施設" with NO subtitle, do not invent an address.

Each row has original clean circular clock outline with12o'clock vertical hand and lower-right diagonal hand in a small pale-neutral-gray disc, aligned at left. Text column aligned throughout. Fine neutral row separators start at TEXT COLUMN left edge, never beneath icons. Preserve exact4rows, label hierarchy and absence of subtitle on last row.
Accent decision: original neutral-gray history glyphs retained as slate #526173 on pale-neutral discs, omit mock mint/green. Original blue More history action is a real navigation CTA; adapt ONLY that action to forest-green gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E with clear white text, soft edge light and subtle shadow. No other accent or selected state.
Pure-white #FFFFFF canvas/card, fine neutral outline, rounded white section, restrained downward elevation, no nested cards or broad tints. Meiryo Regular date12/16, titles14/24, metadata12/16, action14/24, zero tracking, delicate regular weight. Keep Japanese complete, single-line row titles and metadata. Flat frontal high-resolution portrait around3:4 with modest white margin; compact scan-friendly vertical rhythm. No extra heading, history rows, numbers, searchfield, contacts, keyboard, logos or device frame.
